ideas.pitch: An AWS infrastructure monitoring dashboard with a spooky graveyard UI where idle, vulnerable, or over-provisioned cloud resources appear as ghosts and ghouls.
ideas.problem_statement: Create a website, web application, or prototype with a Halloween-themed UI with AWS service integration.
ideas.title: SpookyCloud Sentinel: AWS Cost & Security Monster Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the AWS Student Builder Group sponsor context by integrating actual cloud resource tracking while completely fulfilling the Halloween UI requirement.

ideas.pitch: A multi-language clinical triage and rPPG heart rate monitoring web app disguised as a vampire health assessment tool.
ideas.problem_statement: Create a website, web application, or prototype with a Halloween-themed UI addressing clinical health triage.
ideas.title: HauntedTriage AI: Medical Triage with a Vampire Twist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven high-performance pattern of browser-based sensor monitoring combined with a deeply creative themed UI.

ideas.pitch: A global transport carbon emission optimizer styled like a haunted ship navigator, mapping out eco-friendly shipping routes.
